activity_summary: Mistress Ansell boiled the ink and you paid twopence for the horn. You stayed in. Titus at two is not yours. The Rose's bill is the first Tamburlaine, and you are not going. You went up to begin a leaf with no name at the head.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid twopence, stayed in, and went up to a nameless leaf.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Boiled the ink and priced the horn.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked after Titus, and reported Gib on the stair.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Remained on the stair and did not speak.

facets.activity: Paid for the horn and stayed in

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Twopence the horn, as it always is
